text:
devon: kickoff in 10m for release/2026 cutover. plan: staged network patches (modules/net-routing) then a separate IAM trust tweak in a locked night window. keeping changes minimal.

priya: ack. i'll run the net plan and watch propagation. please confirm provider pin before apply.

marco: i'll own the IAM follow-up if we split. want a full plan run and an annotated rollback snippet before the night window.

infra-bot: scan: provider constraints detected across modules. recommended pin: `provider \"aws\" { version = \"~> 4.2.1\" }`. orphaned resource check: none.

devon: thanks infra-bot. pin is already staged in workspace overrides. running quick preflight now.

deploy-bot: running preflight: `terraform plan -var-file=release-2026.tfvars -target=module.net-routing`

deploy-bot: preflight result: network plan clean. IAM plan (separate) flags: trust-policy update for org-cross-account-role overlaps with external sessions (rule: iam-trust-overlap). suggestion: schedule trust change in maintenance window.

priya: +1 split. network patch is low-risk and required for canary routing. we'll apply network now and hold IAM for maintenance.

devon: ordering: 1) net apply (priya) 2) verify canary health and routing metrics 3) promote traffic 4) schedule IAM at 03:30 UTC and tag oncall.

priya: applying:```
terraform apply -target=module.net-routing -auto-approve
```

deploy-bot: apply streaming: `apply: 4 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`

deploy-bot: apply finished. route tables updated, peering ok.

priya: routes propagated. canary health checks passing. starting 10% traffic shift.

devon: looks good. hold iam for night window. marco please prepare PR that splits trust change from any policy attachments and include these rollback snippets and verification checks.

marco: will do. example rollback steps i'll include:```
# rollback trust to previous state
terraform apply -target=aws_iam_role.org_cross_account -var-file=rollback.tfvars
# verify sessions: `aws sts get-session-token` and check CloudTrail for AssumeRole events
```

oncall: noted. i've booked 03:30 UTC maintenance window and added a PagerDuty override. put the IAM change under the maintenance ticket and tag me in the PR.

devon: added release notes line: "Network routing fixes applied; IAM cross-account trust deferred to maintenance window (03:30 UTC)."

priya: opening a tiny follow-up PR to make the provider pin permanent across envs. will link post-merge.

infra-bot: reminder: avoid mixing stateful IAM trust changes with routing applies in the same window. schedule manual verification for any role-assume updates with external principals.

devon: thanks team. closing this daytime window, will reopen thread for 03:30 UTC IAM run. :lock:
